chunks: Al-Ḥalabī said to him: "Should I mention the Imams, peace be upon them, in the salat (prayer)?" He said: "Mention them collectively."

key_terms.أَجْمِلْهُمْ: mention them in a general or collective manner
key_terms.أُسَمِّي: should I name or mention explicitly
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةَ: the Imams, the divinely appointed leaders
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Ḥalabī, the questioner in this narration

ai.seo_question: Should the names of the Imams عليهم السلام be mentioned individually in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question about how the Imams عليهم السلام are to be mentioned in salat (prayer). The reply directs that they be mentioned collectively rather than naming each one individually.
